experiments.scope: Rounds 3, blake3-r3-prefix-v1. Re-executes the embedded generator and ledger of this package (gate count, program sha256, score) and advances one batch of the emitted net against its scalar reference; per trial it derives start points from the organizer seed and returns two distinct 64-byte messages whose complete digests agree on the low 8 bits.
experiments.hypothesis: The package is self-reproducing: the shipped sources rebuild the emitted program and the ledger rows exactly, the emitted program evaluates the selected target, and a seeded batched search with a bucket table returns real agreeing pairs on that target.
